# `gcp.rowaccesspolicy`

Represents access on a subset of rows on the specified table, defined by its filter predicate. Access to the subset of rows is controlled by its IAM policy.

[bigquery](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | bigquery |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `bigquery.googleapis.com/RowAccessPolicy` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: pre_delete (pre_delete/bigquery_row_access_policy.go.tmpl) always sends force=true. THE BOUNDED GAP: without it, Google refuses to delete a table's LAST row access policy, because that would widen access. The refusal is loud and names the reason.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 60s |
